module: "Layers" panel of the mission editor. A mission looks for its files in an ordered list of folders (mission.layers, each with a dir field) until it finds a matching file. This panel lets you reorder the folders, edit them (text or file picker), open the folder in the explorer, add some after a row or delete them. The module returns a constructor: require(...)(missionEditor).
notes: A layer with fixed = true is disabled for editing (field, picker and deletion).
The first layer is labeled "Checked First", the last "Checked Last".
Adding a folder calls dump(add) (debugging leftover in the log).

C.desc: Instance of the Layers panel. Fields: missionEditor, mission, inputs (imgui text buffers per layer).

setMission.desc: Sets the current mission and recreates the input fields.

createInputFields.desc: Recreates the imgui text buffers (im.ArrayChar of 1024) from layer.dir for each layer.

draw.desc: Draws the list of layers with up/down buttons, path field, folder, picker, deletion and addition. Applies the moves at the end of the frame and sets mission._dirty to true.
